inputs.name: handle.event
inputs.description: The SvelteKit RequestEvent for the current request, passed unchanged to resolve(event) and never read by the hook. It matters only as the input to resolve, and the hook neither validates nor changes it.

inputs.name: handle.resolve
inputs.description: SvelteKit's resolve function, called once as resolve(event) with no ResolveOptions and awaited for the Response that the hook passes to HubResponsesMiddleware. The hook adds no try/catch around that await, so any rejection from resolve propagates out of handle.

outputs.name: handle
outputs.description: The Response that handle resolves to: the same object that resolve(event) returned, after HubResponsesMiddleware sets X-Frame-Options to DENY, Content-Security-Policy to frame-ancestors 'none', Referrer-Policy to no-referrer, X-Content-Type-Options to nosniff and Cache-Control to private, no-store. Each of these five headers replaces any existing value under its name, and the Response is modified in place rather than copied.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by the first response.headers.set call in HubResponsesMiddleware.handle when the Response's Headers are immutable, which the Fetch Headers API reports as a TypeError. Nothing catches it, so handle rejects with it and none of the five security headers are set.

errors.name: resolve(event) rejection
errors.description: The hook awaits resolve(event) with no try/catch, so whatever value resolve rejects with (this code does not define its type) becomes the rejection of handle. In that case HubResponsesMiddleware.handle is never called and no security header is set.
